jobs.description:
### **About Mainspring**

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

* Pragmatic Optimism
* Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

### **Job Overview**

Mainspring is seeking a Senior Product Integration Engineer (CAD) to own and maintain the integrated CAD definition of the Linear Generator as designs evolve. Design Engineers will continue to own the technical design and subsystem CAD; this role will make sure those designs are incorporated into authoritative POR and future-state reference assemblies and work together correctly in the context of the complete product.

This role combines product-definition ownership with hands-on whole-product CAD integration. The ideal candidate is exceptionally strong in 3D CAD, understands how complex mechanical systems fit together, and enjoys resolving packaging, interface, and configuration problems across multiple engineering teams. This role will be a key user of CATIA for full-product assemblies that exceed the practical limits of SolidWorks.

### **Core Responsibilities**

* Build, maintain, and continuously improve authoritative POR and future-state reference assemblies for the Linear Generator

* Integrate subsystem CAD from multiple Design Engineering teams into full-product CATIA assemblies and keep those assemblies current as engineering changes progress

* Maintain clean full-product CAD structure, references, interfaces, metadata, and configuration logic across major assemblies

* Perform packaging studies, interference checks, clearance reviews, routing studies, service-access checks, and assembly-access evaluations

* Identify conflicting space claims and work with Design Engineers to negotiate interfaces and converge on practical whole-product solutions

* Create and maintain reference geometry, interface geometry, envelopes, simplified models, and other integration artifacts needed to support cross-team design work

* Support design reviews with clear visualizations of clashes, interfaces, access constraints, and product-level integration risks

* Identify and resolve inconsistencies among integrated CAD, drawings, EBOM structure, and the intended product configuration before release

* Support Product Release and Configuration Management by providing a clear, traceable digital definition of the product state being released

* Help establish scalable methods and standards for CATIA, large-assembly performance, imported geometry, simplification, reference assemblies, and cross-CAD workflows

### **Qualifications**

* BS in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience

* 5+ years of experience in mechanical CAD, product design, packaging, product integration, or complex equipment design

* Advanced proficiency with CATIA, NX, Creo, SolidWorks, or another advanced 3D CAD platform; strong CATIA experience is highly preferred

* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining large, complex, multi-subsystem assemblies with disciplined reference and configuration practices

* Strong mechanical intuition and ability to identify packaging, clearance, routing, serviceability, assembly, and interface issues from 3D CAD

* Strong understanding of mechanical interfaces, drawings, GD&T, BOMs, revisions, and engineering change workflows

* Ability to communicate spatial and interface problems clearly and collaborate with engineers from multiple subsystem teams

* Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable coordinating multiple design changes that affect interfacing hardware

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience integrating products containing structures, piping/tubing, electrical hardware, thermal systems, enclosures, and serviceable components

* Experience with SolidWorks-to-CATIA or other multi-CAD integration workflows

* Experience with ENOVIA, 3DEXPERIENCE, or another PLM/PDM system

* Experience in complex industrial equipment, aerospace, automotive, robotics, energy systems, or another highly integrated hardware product

This position is **onsite** at our **Menlo Park HQ**. The salary will be adjusted to reflect local market conditions based on employee location as well as the experience of the employee. Along with the base salary, Mainspring offers pre-IPO stock options + benefits.

Does your experience not meet all of our posted requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to positions unless they meet every listed requirement. At Mainspring, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, flexible, and collaborative environment, so if you want to help us transition the world to clean and affordable electricity, and don’t meet all posted requirements for a particular role, we’d still love to hear from you. Mainspring can sometimes be flexible enough to shift responsibilities for the right person, or otherwise identify open or upcoming roles that may better fit your professional background.

At cabi, we're redefining what it means to build a fashion brand—one rooted in connection, confidence, and purpose. As a women's retail clothing company, we don't just design beautiful apparel; we create opportunities for women to express themselves, build community, and thrive both personally and professionally. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and deeply people-first, and every team member plays a role in creating meaningful experiences for our Stylists and clients. If you're energized by creativity, inspired by empowering others, and excited to contribute to a brand that blends style with substance, you'll feel right at home here.

We are looking for a Data Analyst who can own our recurring reporting and also dig into the open-ended questions that come up across the business. About half of the role is keeping our core reporting accurate, reliable, and increasingly automated. The other half is ad hoc analysis and project work, where you'll partner with teams across the company to answer the questions behind their biggest decisions.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys both building things that run smoothly and solving new problems. You should be comfortable taking a loosely defined request, figuring out what's really being asked, and turning it into a clear analysis and recommendation. Because our work goes to executives, the board, and external partners, a high attention to detail is essential.

We also use AI tools every day to work faster and smarter, and we're looking for someone who is excited to do the same.

* + 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related role
* + Strong SQL skills and experience working in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake
* + Hands-on experience building Tableau dashboards from scratch, including data modeling, calculations, and thoughtful visual design
* + Experience building or maintaining data transformation pipelines
* + Regular, practical use of AI tools in your work, and genuine curiosity about how AI can change the way analytics gets done
* + Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical findings to non-technical audiences
* + Ability to take an ambiguous request, ask the right questions, and turn it into a focused analysis
* + High attention to detail: you catch errors before anyone else does, sanity-check numbers against what you know about the business, and hold yourself to a standard of accuracy fit for executive and board reporting
* + Comfort managing several priorities at once and keeping stakeholders updated on progress
* + Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or business, or equivalent experience

**Job Description**

**Discover Impactful Work**

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Our CDx Bioinformatics team contributes to that mission by supporting the development of next-generation sequencing companion diagnostics that help guide cancer treatment.

As a Scientist III, Bioinformatics, you will apply your knowledge of biology, oncology, and genomic data analysis to active diagnostic development programs. Your work will include preparing study datasets, investigating sequencing results, and developing tools that improve the quality and efficiency of scientific analysis.

You will join a collaborative team and work with colleagues in Research and Development, Program Management, Clinical Affairs, Biostatistics, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Software Development. This role offers opportunities to contribute across multiple programs, deepen your expertise in regulated diagnostic development, and apply new computational approaches, including AI-assisted tools, with sound scientific judgment.

**What You Will Do**

* Prepare, curate, and review study datasets, including variant and quality-control line listings, sample metadata, and data transfer packages. Reconcile source data and resolve missing, inconsistent, or unexpected results before delivery.
* Analyze DNA and RNA sequencing results in the context of assay design, oncology biomarkers, and study requirements. Assess variant coverage, reporting eligibility, and differences between assays or analysis configurations.
* Investigate discordant results, unexpected variant calls, no-calls, and quality-control findings. Review sequencing evidence and analysis settings, document the findings, and explain what the evidence does and does not support.
* Prepare program-specific assay definition inputs, including hotspot and variant content files, and perform reanalyses using defined software and configuration versions.
* Provide analyses and technical documentation for study reports, regulatory questions, and partner requests. Maintain traceability to source data, methods, and analysis versions.
* Develop and improve scripts and tools for recurring tasks such as dataset curation, variant comparison, quality checks, and reporting. Test changes, participate in code review, and document methods so others can use and maintain them.
* Use approved AI-assisted tools where useful for coding, troubleshooting, data exploration, and documentation. Independently verify generated code and content before use, with appropriate protection of confidential data.
* Manage assigned deliverables across multiple programs, clarify requirements with collaborators, and communicate findings, dependencies, and delivery risks.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least five years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree with at least three years of relevant experience, in bioinformatics, computational biology, molecular biology, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience analyzing NGS data in oncology, molecular diagnostics, or a closely related setting.
* Experience preparing and reviewing scientific datasets for use by other teams or external collaborators.

**Scientific and Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of molecular biology, cancer genomics, and the relationship between genomic alterations and diagnostic assay design.
* Working knowledge of NGS data processing, variant calling, sequencing quality metrics, and sources of technical error. Experience with Linux/Unix, Git, and common sequencing data formats such as BAM and VCF.
* Experience interpreting relevant variant classes, such as SNVs, indels, copy-number alterations, gene fusions, and splice variants.
* Proficiency in Python or another suitable analysis language, including the ability to write, troubleshoot, and review code independently.
* Ability to reconcile data from multiple sources and build reproducible analyses with documented assumptions and quality checks.
* Practical familiarity with AI-assisted tools and their limitations, including the ability to identify and correct unsupported or incorrect outputs.
* Ability to explain technical findings clearly, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and recognize when further analysis or specialist input is needed.

**Preferred Experience**

* Companion diagnostic development or analytical and clinical validation studies.
* Targeted oncology sequencing of FFPE tissue or plasma specimens.
* Work in a regulated or quality-controlled environment, including documented analysis methods, version control, and review requirements.
* Preparation of partner data transfers, study-report datasets, or analyses supporting regulatory submissions.

The incumbent will initially receive training in relevant laboratory techniques and, with increasing proficiency, will take on greater responsibility for independent experiments and research projects.
